metadata.title: त्रिपुरा हिंसा | एकलव्य स्कूल और आदिवासी भाषा | Tripura Violence| EMRS and tribal languages
metadata.description: Two major news stories from Northeast India to discuss. Firstly, the escalating tensions in Tripura following the death of a Tribal student. Secondly, the Nagaland state government's petition against a central order in the Supreme Court, which is over a year old, pertaining to EMRS (Eklavya Model Residential School) schools allegedly imposing Hindi on tribal students. Lastly, we'll delve into the Maharally held in Mangad Dham regarding the demands of Bhil Pradesh, and finally, we'll discuss an incident in Kerala where an elephant attack resulted in death of a tribal.
